_about: Public-domain Thomas Edward Bridgett (1829-1899, Redemptorist historian) for the Word Hoard: 6 volumes from Internet Archive scans: Our Lady's Dowry (1875), the History of the Holy Eucharist in Great Britain (2 vols, 1881), Blunders and Forgeries (1890) and his lives of John Fisher (1888) and Thomas More (1891). Written in English. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 28 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

bridgett-thomas-more: Life and Writings of Sir Thomas More (London: Burns & Oates, 1891)
